author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this talk, Laura Prather shares how her belief in free speech sparked by a high school teacher was tested when she witnessed the legal system used to silence truth. As a human rights lawyer, she saw firsthand how Lance Armstrong weaponized lawsuits to intimidate critics, revealing a growing threat known as SLAPPs: Strategic Lawsuits Against Public Participation. Laura explains how these cases financially and emotionally punish people simply for speaking out, from students to caregivers. She argues that free speech depends on strong Anti-SLAPP laws, which stop abusive lawsuits early and protect ordinary citizens. Her message is a call to defend democracy by standing up to legal bullies and safeguarding everyone’s right to speak.

title: How legal bullying works—and how to protect yourself | Laura Prather | TEDxSurrey

description: Yara explores the topic of comparison, whether it appears on social media, in school, or even within our own thoughts. Her talk asks an important question: what does comparison actually cost us? Cost of Comparison discusses how comparing, especially through social media platforms, slowly and quietly affect teens' self esteem and identity. It explains the psychology behind why our brains are wired to compare, and illustrates the different comparisons we use everyday. The talk also emphasizes on how these comparisons play a role in teenagers building their identity. All in all, it motivates people to compare themselves to their past selves instead of others. author: TEDx Talks
description:
This talk presents mindfulness through a more direct and grounded lens, shaped by personal loss, identity shifts, and psychological insight. Dr. Shambhavi Samir Alve begins by questioning a common assumption. Unity is often treated as something external, yet the real conflict lies within the self.
Drawing from her recent experience with endometrial cancer and the emotional impact of losing organs tied to identity, she examines what remains when familiar definitions fall away. In that space, she introduces the idea of “Kali” not as a symbol of destruction, but as a form of clear awareness that cuts through illusion.
The talk connects this inner process to broader social dynamics. When individuals fail to understand their own emotional complexity, they struggle to accept differences in others. True unity, she argues, depends on the ability to sit with discomfort, contradiction, and change.
At the centre of the talk is a practical framework: the K.A.L.I formula, which stands for Know, Ac
title: Awaken the Kali Within: A Mindfulness Equation | Dr. Shambhavi Samir Alve | TEDxGGSIPU

description: Jade explores a topic that is shaping our future: artificial intelligence, but maybe not in the way you expect. Because sometimes, the real focus is not the technology, it’s us. AI is not the threat; we are. This talk explores how deepfake technology and AI-generated media are eroding trust, harming individuals, and reshaping reality as we know it. Through evidence of rapid growth in synthetic media and our collective failure to detect it, the talk confronts the real-world consequences we are only beginning to understand. Yet AI also saves lives, unlocks education, and accelerates discovery. The technology is not the problem. The problem is us: our choices, our ethics, and the responsibility we keep outsourcing to machines. description:
What if impostor syndrome isn’t a personal flaw, but a predictable response to broken systems?

In this talk, Dr. Nellie Tran, a community psychologist and researcher, challenges one of the most widely accepted narratives about confidence. Instead of asking individuals to “fake it till they make it,” she reveals how schools and workplaces reward the performance of confidence over the development of real skill. This disconnect leaves many people, especially those navigating bias and exclusion, questioning their worth rather than questioning the system.

Drawing from research and lived experience, Dr. Tran shows how impostor feelings are shaped by inequitable environments, unspoken rules, and who gets recognized as “competent.” She introduces a powerful reframe. You are not an impostor. You are an infiltrator, entering spaces that were never designed with you in mind.

This talk invites a shift from self-doubt to self-trust, from performance to practice, and from individual blame to col
title: You’re Not an Imposter. You’re an Infiltrator | Nellie Tran | TEDxSDSU

Why do overlooked places keep losing their best people, and what would it take to make them destinations again?

In this talk, Jesudamilare Adesegun-David names three plagues holding secondary cities and underserved university communities back: the plague of placelessness, the tyranny of short-term thinking, and the plague of isolation. He argues that these forces quietly erode commitment, vision, and collective progress.

Drawing from years of building patiently in Ogbomoso, a non-obvious city, he offers three clear antidotes: place, patience, and community. When leadership is rooted in place, guided by long-term thinking, and strengthened by shared effort, such places can become centers of meaning, opportunity, and global relevance.

Their future, he reminds us, will not be rushed, outsourced, or imported. It will be built by those willing to stay. Jesudamilare “JD” Adesegun-David is a Thought Alchemist and Community Transformation Strategist, and co-founder/CEO of Ennovate Lab, bui

Sua fala nos conduz por reflexões sobre pertencimento, preservação da Mata Atlântica, saberes tradicionais e o direito dos povos originários de manter viva sua própria história.

In this engaging talk, he shares the journey of how a quest for the perfect 'Paloma' led to the creation of Three Cents, a brand that disrupted the global beverage industry. By leveraging the 'pull strategy' of the bartending community and embracing a healthy dose of 'risk ignorance,' he and his partners proved that innovation isn't about following market rules—it's about reflecting real needs. From hand-bottling sodas in a basement to competing with multinational giants, this is a story of how dreaming big and staying 'stubbornly' authentic can turn a niche idea into a global category leader. In this deeply moving talk, Séblé shares her quest to answer the simple yet heavy question: 'Who are you?' After years of trying to fit into the rigid boxes of nationality, occupation, and social roles, she found her true reflection through the unlikely path of entrepreneurship. By founding a leather-craft brand, she learned to literally and metaphorically stitch together the fragments of her heritage—African vibrance, French elegance, and Greek geometry. Her story is a powerful reminder that identity isn't a single label we are born with, but a mosaic we build with our own hands. title: Opening Your Eyes to a Different Truth | Zaeem Islam | TEDxBISHCMC Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: From banking transactions and weather forecasting to national security and global navigation, aerospace technology has become an invisible yet indispensable thread in the fabric of our daily lives. In this compelling talk, Vaios Lappas explores the concept of 'reflections' - both as a fundamental physical principle used by satellites to monitor climate change and detect wildfires, and as a metaphor for national introspection. By highlighting the strategic importance of satellite data as 'the new gold' and presenting the ambitious €200M National Microsatellite Program, the speaker showcases how Greece is evolving from a consumer of space tech to a producer with 'Made in Greece' satellites. Through the lens of aerospace innovation, we are invited to rethink our potential, investing in human capital and excellence to prove that when it comes to technology and development, 'impossible is nothing'. Professor Vaios Lappas is the Chair of the newly established Department of Aerospace Science
title: Reflections from Space | Vaios Lappas | TEDxUniversity of Piraeus

author: TEDx Talks
description: How many heartbreaks does it take to finally meet your true self? In this raw and deeply relatable talk, [Speaker's Name] explores how a single cancelled date and an unanswered message can trigger a spiral of anxiety, insecurity, and ancient traumas. Using the psychological lens of 'self-reflection,' he deconstructs the invisible threads that connect our current romantic frustrations to the wounds of our past. From the physical toll of 'toxic' attractions to the courage required to stop performing for others, this talk reveals that every relationship is essentially a mirror. It challenges the notion that love is a clinical disorder and offers a liberating path toward bravery: the act of being your authentic self. Discover why losing someone else might be the only way to ensure you never lose the most important person of all—yourself. Dr. George Lagios holds a Master’s degree in Psychology, specializing in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), and a PhD in Sexology. He is a Professor of
title: The Mirror of Love: Why We Lose Ourselves in Others | George Lagios | TEDxUniversity of Piraeus

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What happens when your body screams in pain, but your soul refuses to stay silent? World-renowned artistic swimmer [Speaker's Name] shares her odyssey from a young girl being told she wasn’t 'enough' to standing on the highest podium in the world. Through a journey marked by grueling 12-hour training sessions, physical exhaustion, and recurring psychosomatic signals, she reveals how the water became a mirror for her deepest fears and greatest triumphs. This is a story of 'losing before winning' and the power of visualization—how imagining oneself covered in gold can manifest reality even when political and physical odds are stacked against you. An inspiring look at professional sports, resilience, and the unwavering belief that our external reality is a direct reflection of our internal persistence. Evangelia is a World Champion in Artistic Swimming, ranked No. 1 in the world, a 4-time Olympian, and the holder of 8 major international medals!
From breathtaking routines to Olympic fina
title: The Soul’s Reflection in the Water | Evangelia Platanioti | TEDxUniversity of Piraeus

author: TEDx Talks
description: At 28, Nikos Xydas was told it was time to shut down his company. He had no degree, no funding, and no Plan B. Yet, what seemed like a dead end was merely the beginning of a twenty-year journey defined by a single trait: grit. In this candid and insightful talk, Nikos dismantles the myth of the 'overnight success' and shares how he navigated betrayal, financial instability, and industry gatekeepers. By reframing obstacles not as misfortunes, but as life’s 'algorithm' providing direction, he explains how he built Humble and Scrollstoppers into multi-million euro ventures. Whether it’s decoding human psychology in the workplace or leveraging social media to bypass traditional networking, Nikos proves that reality eventually reflects your inner persistence. This is a story for anyone who feels they are lagging behind their peers, offering a powerful reminder that while we can’t control the punches life throws, we can use them to fuel our evolution. Nikos Xydas is the founder of Humble Ag
title: The Life Algorithm: Why Obstacles are Your Best Guide | Nikos Xydas | TEDxUniversity of Piraeus

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if the reflection you see in the mirror isn't actually yours, but a distorted image imposed by an outdated educational system? In this engaging dual talk, Yannis and Christos revisit their school years—from failed puppet shows in history class to the dry theory of 1990s computer labs—to expose why traditional education often stifles curiosity. They introduce Zone01 Athens, a revolutionary space with no teachers, no classrooms, and no schedules, where F-16 pilots and stay-at-home moms learn to code side-by-side. By shifting the focus from passive consumption to peer-to-peer creation, they demonstrate how we can bridge the global 'skills gap' and reclaim our authentic potential. This talk is a provocative call to stop looking at who you were told to be and start reflecting on who you can become when you have the freedom to build, play, and fail together. Christos Avramoudis and Ioannis Michalopoulos join us to present a pioneering educational hub that introduced a unique peer-to-pe
title: Breaking the Mirror of Education: Learning with Others | Zone01 Athens | TEDxUniversity of Piraeus

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Is the world inside us a mirror of the world around us? Psychotherapist Irene Latsiou explores the profound connection between self-discovery and social contribution. Drawing from her experience as Head of People & Culture at Humanity Greece, she argues that the journey to our authentic self has no shortcuts—it requires time, courage, and a shift from the 'couch of thoughts' to the 'field of action.' Latsiou reveals why volunteering is deeply therapeutic: it strips away social labels, teaches the lost art of active listening, and fosters empathy. In a world of 'shoulds' and distractions, she invites us to change our internal reflection by touching the lives of others. This moving talk is a call to be present, reminding us that the image we see in the mirror is not just our own—it is the sum of every gaze we’ve met and every act of kindness we’ve chosen to perform. Humanity Greece is a dynamic non-profit organization promoting solidarity and humanity.
It operates throughout Greece, off
title: The Therapeutic Power of Presence | Irene Latsiou | TEDxUniversity of Piraeus

description:
‘Wellness is not just for adults! ’ explains Kiyan Kapur, as he explores the gap between the mental health support young students need and what they actually receive. 

Drawing from his experience creating a peer-led Wellness Council, he shows how early intervention and genuine peer connection can shape how young people cope and grow. His message is simple but powerful: you don’t need to start a project to make a difference. Sometimes, just noticing, being kind, and uplifting someone is enough to change everything. Kiyan Kapur, as the outgoing Head Boy of Symbiosis International School, will be studying Biology and Entrepreneurship at Tufts University in the fall of ‘26. 

He has led several student-driven wellness and mental health initiatives, most notably founding the ‘Wellness Council’, and has built a community of over 14,000 through his YouTube platform, ‘Wellness Whispers’.

title: Wellness is Not Just for Adults!  | Kiyan Kapur | TEDxSIS Pune Youth

description: What can tomatoes, lunchboxes and  traffic possibly have in common and how is that any helpful for us? In this talk, Vivaan Arya explores an unexpected form of intelligence: the kind built not through formal theory, but through experience, instinct and constraint. Blending mathematics, economics and everyday life, “The Mathematics of Making Do” challenges how we define knowledge itself. Vivaan Arya is a Grade 12 student at Symbiosis International School, Pune, and an incoming Computer Science major at the University of Michigan. Driven by a curiosity to solve real-world problems through technology, he has built applications for healthcare clinics and businesses while exploring cryptography through independent research. A student leader and founder of his school’s computer science club, he works to make technology and digital safety more accessible to others. As Trinity College London Grade 8 distinction holder in acting, Vivaan brings together technical thinking, communication, and le
title: The Mathematics of Making Do | Vivaan Arya | TEDxSIS Pune Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: The Human Method: A manual approach in an automated world is about ways to battle cognitive fatigue caused by excessive use of generative AI. The talk explores neurographic art and how regularly practising it can strengthen the brain. Suhana Stephen is a DP2 student at Symbiosis International School Pune. She will continue at Symbiosis School of Liberal Arts to pursue a B.A in Liberal Arts. Her main interests are English and Economics. She is also passionate about leadership and has been a part of the student council for 2 years as Prefect and Head Girl. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Human Method: a manual approach in an automated world | Suhana Stephen | TEDxSIS Pune Youth

description:
In a world obsessed with startups and ballooned valuations, what’s the true power of a successor? Shlok Ranka, a 7th-generation jeweler, explores how to bridge 147 years of heritage with modern innovation. Discover why a unified family vision and "boring" profitability are the ultimate competitive advantages in 2026 I am a 7th-generation jeweler, but I’ve always believed that legacy is a living thing. While many of my peers headed abroad after Grade 12, I chose to stay rooted—joining our family business immediately while balancing a B.Com at Symbiosis with four specialized industry diplomas. This journey eventually took me to Milan for a Masters at Istituto Marangoni.

Today, as a Partner at Ranka Jewellers, my generation is focused on bridging a hundred-year-old legacy with 21st-century technology, design, and innovation. title: Carring the school's Imprint Forward | Shlok Ranka | TEDxSIS Pune Youth

description:
Twenty years ago, I stood at a crossroads in a family of academic achievers, drawn to DANCE, a path that felt impractical and was hard for even my Dad to believe in. 
I chose safer options and built a bag business, yet never let go of my passion. As time evolved, so did opportunities. Today, wedding choreography is a thriving career and my dad is incredibly proud of what I do. What once seemed invalid is now embraced! 
Choosing innovative dreams are  uncomfortable and often questioned, but they are just ahead of their time and so was I. I’m so glad I chose to stay! I’m Anjali Damani — a wedding choreographer who believes that dance is not just about steps, but about stories.

Trained in Bharatanatyam, Jazz, and Hip-Hop, my journey has been a blend of tradition, rhythm, and evolution. Over the years, I’ve had the privilege of choreographing more than 150 weddings — each one unique, emotional, and full of life.

title: Reinventing Legacy  | Anjali Damani | TEDxSIS Pune Youth
